recommendations.thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue and PAT both grew 25% year on year to ₹57,553 crore and ₹4,588 crore. The auto business reported 55% PAT growth and the company reported 21% annualised consolidated ROE. This gives the group a credible multi-business growth profile; the farm segment was weaker, so monitor whether the auto strength remains broad-based.
recommendations.catalyst: Sustained SUV and electric-SUV execution, continued market-share gains, and recovery in farm-equipment demand.
recommendations.risk: Auto demand and competitive intensity, EV investment and execution, farm cyclicality, and valuation risk if strong growth is already priced in.
recommendations.invalidation: Several quarters of slowing auto volumes or market-share loss, sustained margin deterioration, or a material deterioration in group cash generation / returns.
recommendations.source: Mahindra & Mahindra Q2 FY27 results (5 Nov 2026)

recommendations.thesis: Q2 FY27 net profit rose 14.28% year on year to ₹23,038 crore and net interest income rose 14.69%. Advances grew 17.84%; gross NPA was 1.39% and net NPA 0.36%. The combination of loan growth and reported asset-quality improvement supports a medium-term watchlist case, subject to tracking deposit costs and margins.
recommendations.catalyst: Continued domestic credit growth, operating leverage, and stable or improving asset quality.
recommendations.risk: Deposit competition and funding costs, NIM compression, unsecured / corporate credit slippage, and broader economic or credit-cycle deterioration.
recommendations.invalidation: A sustained rise in slippages and credit costs, weakening deposit mobilisation, or repeated NIM compression that undermines earnings growth.
recommendations.source: State Bank of India Q2 FY27 results (3 Nov 2026)
